title: Board action
description: The record of one agenda item taken up by a board, council, commission or committee: the meeting, who attended, the motions made, who moved and seconded them, each member's vote, recusals and the outcome. Informed by parliamentary procedure as described in Robert's Rules of Order and by common open-meetings practice. Works for corporate boards and public bodies alike.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The $id of this schema, so readers can tell what the record is.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: The version of this format the record follows.

id.description: This record's identifier, unique within the system that created it.

externalIds.title: External identifiers
externalIds.description: Ids for this action in other systems, for example a legislative management or board portal system.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed.

body.title: Body
body.description: The board, council, commission or committee that acted.

name.title: Name
name.description: The body's name, for example Board of Directors or Planning Commission.

type.title: Body type
type.description: board-of-directors, board-committee, board-of-trustees, city-council, county-board, school-board, planning-commission, authority-board, advisory-committee or other.

organization.description: The organization the body governs, for corporate and nonprofit boards.

jurisdiction.description: The public body's jurisdiction, if any.

publicBody.title: Public body
publicBody.description: Whether open-meetings law applies to the body.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: The meeting at which the item was taken up.

type.title: Meeting type
type.description: regular, special, emergency, annual, closed-session or workshop.

scheduledStart.description: When the meeting was scheduled to start.

calledToOrderAt.description: When the meeting was called to order.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the meeting was held, including any remote access details made public.

remoteParticipation.title: Remote participation
remoteParticipation.description: Whether members could take part remotely.

noticePostedAt.description: When public notice of the meeting was posted.

openToPublic.title: Open to the public
openToPublic.description: Whether the public could attend this part of the meeting.

closedSessionBasis.title: Closed session basis
closedSessionBasis.description: The legal basis for closing the meeting, as cited locally, when it was closed.

presidingOfficerId.description: The member id of the presiding officer.

quorum.title: Quorum
quorum.description: Whether enough voting members were present to act.

required.title: Required
required.description: Voting members needed for a quorum.

present.title: Present
present.description: Voting members present when the item was taken up.

members.title: Members
members.description: Every member of the body for this meeting and whether they attended. Motions, votes and recusals refer to members by id.

id.description: Identifier for the member, used by motions, votes and recusals.

seat.title: Seat
seat.description: Office or seat, for example Chair, District 3 or Independent Director.

voting.title: Voting member
voting.description: Whether the member has a vote (false for ex officio non-voting members).

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: present, remote, absent, excused or arrived-late.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: The item the body took up.

number.title: Number
number.description: The item's number on the agenda, for example 7.b.

section.title: Section
section.description: consent, action, public-hearing, discussion, report or closed-session.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The staff or sponsor summary of the item.

attachmentIds.description: Ids of related entries in the record's attachments.

publicComments.title: Public comments
publicComments.description: Comments from the public on the item.

speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: The speaker's name as given; leave out when they did not give one.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What the speaker said, in brief.

motions.title: Motions
motions.description: Motions made on the item, in the order they were made.

recusals.title: Recusals
recusals.description: Members who stepped aside from the item, and why.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: financial-interest, family-relationship, employment, prior-involvement, appearance-of-conflict or other.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: The disclosure, as stated on the record.

leftRoom.title: Left the room
leftRoom.description: Whether the member left during discussion and vote.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: What the body decided on the item.

result.title: Result
result.description: approved, approved-as-amended, denied, continued, referred, tabled, received-and-filed or no-action.

actionNumber.title: Action number
actionNumber.description: The resolution, ordinance or minute order number assigned.

continuedTo.description: The date the item was continued to, if continued.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The decision in plain words, as it will appear in the minutes.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: The state of the minutes that record this action.

uri.title: Location
uri.description: Where the published minutes can be read.

status.description: scheduled, in-progress, decided, minutes-approved or withdrawn.

statusHistory.title: Status history
statusHistory.description: Every status the record has had, oldest first, each one of the values of status.

status.description: The status the record moved to, one of this format's status values.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Files that belong to the item: staff reports, draft resolutions, presentations.

auditTrail.title: Audit trail
auditTrail.description: Recorded actions on the record, oldest first.

extensions.description: Local fields this format doesn't define, namespaced as <namespace>:<field>.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status values of this format.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: A motion, its second, the vote and the result.

id.description: Identifier for the motion, unique within the record.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: main, amend, substitute, refer, postpone, table, take-from-table, reconsider, rescind or other.

appliesToMotionId.description: The motion this one applies to (for amendments, referrals and other secondary motions).

movedBy.description: The member id of the mover.

secondedBy.description: The member id of the seconder.

voteMethod.title: Vote method
voteMethod.description: voice, roll-call, show-of-hands, ballot, electronic or unanimous-consent.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: The vote needed to adopt: majority-of-votes-cast, majority-of-members, two-thirds-of-votes-cast, two-thirds-of-members, unanimous or other.

votes.title: Votes
votes.description: Each member's vote. Members who were absent or recused are listed with that value so the record is complete.

vote.title: Vote
vote.description: yes, no, abstain, absent or recused.

tally.title: Tally
tally.description: The counted result. Must match the individual votes when they are given.

result.title: Result
result.description: adopted, failed, withdrawn, ruled-out-of-order, died-for-lack-of-second, tabled, postponed or referred.
